objective.name: tokens.count
objective.description: Count the input tokens of a canonical inference request through the provider, without running the inference.

#root.role: Give the exact number of input tokens the provider would bill for a canonical request, to measure what each part of a prompt costs.

request._comment: A canonical inference request (/root/llm/schema/request). Only model, messages and output are read; max_output_tokens is not needed.

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical request becomes the number of input tokens its provider counts for it.
notes: The body is the one infer.anthropic builds from the same request, without max_tokens and the sampling parameters.
invariants: No inference is run and nothing is generated.
The request is a transit value: no Matter is read, written or created, and nothing is persisted.
A provider other than anthropic is an explicit invalid-request failure.
A provider failure is an explicit failure carrying the provider's status and message.
